description: This file contains unit tests for the GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzer, which enforces rules preventing properties in certain Orleans grain interfaces to ensure RPC clarity and consistency. It verifies various cases where properties are allowed or disallowed in interfaces like IGrain, IAddressable, and IGrainObserver.

classes.name: GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the analyzer that enforces rules on properties within various grain-related interfaces in Orleans.

methods.name: GrainInterfacePropertyNoError
methods.description: Tests that interfaces with only methods pass without diagnostics.

methods.name: NoPropertiesAllowedInGrainInterface
methods.description: Tests that properties in IGrain interfaces trigger diagnostics.

methods.name: NoPropertiesAllowedInIAddressableInterface
methods.description: Tests that properties in IAddressable interfaces trigger diagnostics.

methods.name: NoPropertiesAllowedInIGrainObserverInterface
methods.description: Tests that properties in IGrainObserver interfaces trigger diagnostics.

methods.name: StaticInterfacePropertiesAllowedInGrainInterface
methods.description: Tests that static properties in grain interfaces are permitted.

methods.name: StaticInterfacePropertiesAllowedInAddressableInterface
methods.description: Tests that static properties in IAddressable interfaces are permitted.
